card.name: Treatment regimen words after recommended
card.fires_on: Nouns like treatment, regimen and induction (including the pieces Reg and imen) that name a therapy plan, usually right after words like recommended or suggested in dosing sections and tables.

modes.label: Regimen after recommended
modes.description: The word regimen or treatment right after recommended or suggested in dosing text.

modes.label: Inside regimen
modes.description: Partway through the word regimen or induction in table headings or cancer dosing text.
